A-wegman-zadeck-sccp-1991.relevance-description: Carries three constraints 28Q's kernel inherits whether or not it notices: (1) §5.1's optimistic-vs-pessimistic split — an optimistic fixpoint is WRONG if halted early, a pessimistic one is merely poor, which prices any analysis-budget/timeout the kernel might want; (2) §5.3's nodes-vs-edges result — the executable flag must key to EDGES, node-keying silently loses facts, the direct analogue of keying availability to positions-between-statements rather than statements; (3) §5.2's def-use-vs-SSA result — a def-use-chain-shaped index is quadratic AND less precise than an SSA-shaped one, which is exactly the shape 28Q §1's DefinitionId keying risks. Also a positive data point for the unification thesis: combining constant-propagation with unreachable-code elimination beats iterating them separately.
